Following Jimmy Carter's death in December 2024, he is the earliest-serving living former U.S. president and the last surviving president to have served in the 20th century. Clinton was born as William Jefferson Blythe III on August 19, 1946, at the Julia Chester Hospital in Hope, Arkansas.

The reputation of Bill Clinton was built in the middle, not at the edges. He is the son of William Jefferson Blythe Jr., a traveling salesman who died in an automobile accident three months before his birth, and Virginia Dell Cassidy (later Virginia Kelley). Clinton's parents married on September 4, 1943, but this union later proved bigamous, as Blythe was still married to his fourth wife.

At a time when the southern United States was racially segregated, Clinton's grandparents sold goods on credit to people of all races.
